run.methodology: 项目背景/亚马逊选品调研方法论.md

sources.scope: US keyword detail and 24-month trend for algae calcium
Calcium node 3774291, current Top 100 and trend metrics
Five selected algae-calcium competitors, product details, recent negative reviews and Customers Say
US, past five years, Web Search

sources.notes: Tavily Search API authentication succeeded. Current Codex process must be restarted before the configured Tavily MCP can inherit the newly saved user environment variable.

source_usage.scope: Legacy example created before per-call accounting was introduced.
notes: Historical tool-call counts were not recorded and are not inferred from the final report.

primary_keyword_selection.definition: Fixed primary-keyword selection from Sorftime demand, Top20 relevance, intent, coverage and sales support
primary_keyword_selection.notes: This legacy example predates the primary-keyword selection module.

amazon_keyword_detail.definition: Current Sorftime keyword detail for the exact phrase algae calcium
amazon_keyword_detail.notes: The exact keyword is low-volume and the results contain semantically unrelated calcium products.

amazon_keyword_trend_12m.definition: Exact-keyword monthly series, July 2025 through June 2026, compared with the preceding 12 months
amazon_keyword_trend_12m.notes: Direction is mixed and roughly stable, not a continuous six-month decline.

keyword_drift_analysis.definition: Term-family trends and Top20 organic-result overlap, with branded and non-branded demand kept separate
keyword_drift_analysis.notes: This legacy example predates the keyword-drift module; a new run must collect the term family before upgrading the market gate.

google_trends_web_5y.definition: Google Trends US Web Search, five-year query window
google_trends_web_5y.notes: Relative interest only; it is not Amazon search volume.

top10_monthly_units.definition: Top 10 products in the broad Calcium category node 3774291, sorted by monthly units
top10_monthly_units.notes: Broad category evidence; it is not an algae-calcium-only Top 10.

category_trend.definition: Broad Calcium node 3774291 Top 100 trend, July 2025 through June 2026 versus previous 12 months
category_trend.notes: Broad category grew while the exact keyword was roughly stable.

trend_classification.definition: Combined interpretation of exact Amazon keyword, broad category, and Google Web Search
trend_classification.notes: Amazon exact-keyword average is down 5.43%, broad-category units are up 11.22%, and Google Web Search interest is up 62.03%.

seasonality_classification.definition: Exact Amazon keyword recent-12-month peak/trough and Google Trends variation
seasonality_classification.notes: Amazon keyword peak 2162 versus trough 594; Google Web Search also shows a sharp 2026 spike.

gate.notes: Demand exists, but exact-keyword scale is small and the cross-source trend signals are not aligned.

top20_products.definition: Broad Calcium category node 3774291 current Top 20 by monthly units
top20_products.notes: This scope is broader than algae calcium and is retained as category context.

strict_algae_subset.definition: Six high-confidence products whose title or brand explicitly supports an algae-calcium interpretation
strict_algae_subset.notes: This is a semantic subset, not a complete ranked Top 20.

new_listing_share_6m_top20.definition: Broad Calcium Top 20 listings first available on or after 2026-01-14 divided by 20
new_listing_share_6m_top20.notes: High-competition signal under the methodology threshold. Exact algae subset is also 0 of 6, but the subset is incomplete.

sorftime_new_product_sales_share_3m_top1.definition: Sorftime-reported share of category Top 100 sales from products listed within three months
sorftime_new_product_sales_share_3m_top1.notes: A separate Sorftime proxy; it does not replace the six-month listing-count metric.

review_concentration_top3_top10.definition: Review count of broad-category Top 3 products divided by review count of broad-category Top 10 products
review_concentration_top3_top10.notes: Low-concentration signal in the broad category. The strict six-product algae subset is 71.26% for Top 3/Top 6, a high-concentration signal but not the formal Top 3/Top 10 metric.

brand_listing_concentration_top3_top20.definition: Listing count of the three most frequent brands divided by the broad-category Top 20
brand_listing_concentration_top3_top20.notes: Broad category. In the strict algae subset, ALGAECAL alone holds 3 of 6 listings.

unit_concentration_top3_top10.definition: Monthly units of broad-category Top 3 divided by broad-category Top 10
unit_concentration_top3_top10.notes: Broad category. In the strict six-product algae subset, Top 3/Top 6 is 77.21%, which signals a much more concentrated niche.

sorftime_category_proxies.definition: Sorftime current category report proxy metrics for node 3774291
sorftime_category_proxies.notes: Proxy definitions differ from the methodology metrics and are not substituted for them.

value.candidate_gap: 35-50 USD in the strict six-product subset

price_bands.notes: The apparent strict-subset gap is not a confirmed market gap because the semantic subset is incomplete and broader plant-calcium products occupy this range.

entry_position.value: Potential mid-premium algae-calcium format with easier daily use and stronger physical stability, subject to a complete semantic Top 20 and formula/compliance validation.
entry_position.definition: Candidate entry position derived from price and complaint evidence
entry_position.notes: The niche has concentrated sales and no recent high-confidence entrants, so this is a validation hypothesis rather than a recommendation.

gate.notes: Broad category appears distributed, but the strict niche is concentrated and lacks recent entrants.

value.reason: Gummy format and lower price tier
Tablet format using Icelandic red algae

selected_competitors.definition: Five competitors selected for volume, price tier, brand, and dosage-form coverage

negative_review_sample_size.definition: Sorftime negative reviews from the recent one-year window
negative_review_sample_size.notes: Only 44 reviews were returned; expand the Sorftime competitor set to reach the target.

value.examples: broken tablets; dried, melted, stale, moldy or sticking gummies; expired unit
nausea, constipation, cramps, bloating or abdominal discomfort
rash, hives, itching, sore throat or suspected red-algae sensitivity
large or sharp tablets, shattering when cut, multiple units per daily serving
one-month supply misunderstood, missing expected ingredients, concern about combined minerals

complaint_clusters.definition: One primary complaint code per relevant statement in the 44 returned negative reviews; logistics-only noise was separated
complaint_clusters.notes: Counts are directional because the 100-review target was not met. Customers Say independently corroborates digestive tolerance and pill-size themes.

customers_say_corroboration.definition: Aggregated Amazon Customers Say topics returned by Sorftime
customers_say_corroboration.notes: Aggregate topic counts corroborate themes but do not replace the missing individual review sample.

candidate_price_position.definition: Gap in the strict six-product price list
candidate_price_position.notes: Must be rechecked against a complete algae-calcium product set; broader plant-calcium products already occupy this interval.

value.hypothesis: Use a smoother, smaller unit with verified drop, friability and transit stability tests; clearly state units per serving.

value.pain_point: Gummy drying, melting and batch inconsistency
value.hypothesis: If using gummies, validate heat stability, moisture control, packaging barrier and batch appearance before choosing the format.
Run formulation and tolerance review with qualified professionals and test serving-size instructions; do not convert anecdotal reviews into a medical promise.
Show days of supply, units per day and included nutrients prominently and consistently across label, images and listing copy.

product_improvements.definition: Product-development hypotheses mapped to repeated user complaints
product_improvements.notes: All formulation and safety hypotheses require professional and compliance review.

value: Can a complete semantic Top 20 confirm whether the 35-50 USD interval is genuinely under-served?
Can at least 56 additional informative negative reviews be obtained without requiring an unauthorized login action?
Which algae-calcium source, form and serving pattern can improve daily use while remaining label-accurate and compliant?
Do independent off-Amazon sources corroborate a sustained consumer trend rather than a temporary 2026 spike?
Does a production-ready dosage form pass transit, heat, moisture and breakage tests?
open_validation_questions.definition: Questions that could materially change the differentiation decision

gate.notes: Repeated problems exist, but the individual-review target and off-Amazon validation are incomplete.

decision.summary: Demand is real and broad calcium is large, but the exact algae-calcium niche is small, semantically noisy and concentrated. Validate the complete niche set, additional reviews and independent off-Amazon evidence before advancing.

missing_fields.impact: Formal niche-level Top 3/Top 10 concentration and price-gap calculations cannot be finalized.
Complaint counts remain directional; 56 more informative reviews are needed.

findings.claim: Human evidence exists for Aquamin as a red-algae-derived multimineral intervention.
findings.assessment: The located 90-day human trial studied colonic mucosal markers, not Amazon demand or bone-density outcomes, so it cannot substantiate a bone-density product promise.
findings.source_title: A Multi-Mineral Intervention to Modulate Colonic Mucosal Protein Profile

findings.claim: Calcium supplement structure/function claims require substantiation and appropriate disclaimer language.
findings.assessment: Product positioning should stay with normal structure/function language and avoid disease-treatment wording.

findings.claim: Commercial market pages describe growing interest in plant-based calcium.
findings.assessment: The sources are commercial market-report pages and did not provide sufficiently transparent algae-calcium-specific US evidence, so they do not upgrade the demand gate.

conflicts.evidence_a: Sorftime exact-keyword recent 12-month average is 5.43% below the previous 12 months.
conflicts.evidence_b: Google Web Search recent 52-week average is 62.03% above the previous 52 weeks.
conflicts.resolution: Classify as stable_or_mixed and retain VERIFY.

conflicts.evidence_a: Broad Calcium Top 3/Top 10 unit share is 44.07% and review share is 49.06%.
conflicts.evidence_b: Strict six-product algae subset Top 3/Top 6 unit share is 77.21% and review share is 71.26%.
conflicts.resolution: Treat the niche as potentially concentrated and collect a complete semantic Top 20.
